## Session A · 2:05–3:15

Which figure answers which question, and why. Exploring distributions, time, and space; developing the instinct to be curious about a dataset before modelling it. Then the flip side: what figures hide — aggregation, scale, binning, projection, cherry-picked windows — and how to read a published figure for what it is not showing

## Session B · 3:35–4:30

Every session B opens with a ten-minute team check-in: what you did
since last week, what is stuck, and who is doing what next. Written
down, and handed in with that session's work.

Rebuild a published figure from its underlying data, then produce the version you think is more honest. Then make the one figure your own project will live or die on — the picture that would show your effect if it is there — and bring it to the room

Your team's output is submitted before you leave.
